snippet.title: SPIRIT TALK | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026.2 (June)
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist SPIRIT TALK on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002100/Spirit_Talk__Cozy_Visual_Novel/
🌐 Join the Mundo Gamer Network ecosystem (free): https://mundogamer.network/register

A cozy fantasy visual novel where you play a witch who talks to spirits, crafts potions and helps neighbors find peace.

From the Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026.2 (June).
